title: European Dope League

[[Image:league-logo.png|right|Leaguename Logo]] == Introduction == European [[2on2]] tournament which had 12 groups each had 10 teams in them, unfortunatly not all of those teams actually played games. The playoff had 32 teams and was supposed to be double elimination but turned into single elimination because of inactivity.
